title: Guest Room Damage and Incident Report
brief: A hotel housekeeping damage and incident report drafted by an AI assistant for a floor supervisor following a room inspection.

slip.document:
# Guest Room Damage and Incident Report
Highland Crest Hotel & Suites - Property #412

## Incident Details
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Date Reported | 03/14/2026 |
| Inspection Time | 10:45 AM |
| Room Number | 418 |
| Room Status | Departure / Vacant Dirty |
| Guest Name | Wendy Ellison |
| Attendant | Maria Okafor |
| Floor Supervisor | Gordon Quinn |

## Property Damage Findings
Upon standard departure turnover, attendant Maria Okafor noted physical damage to fixtures and furnishings in Room 418.

- The right-side bedside lamp base is fractured, and the linen lampshade has heavy brown liquid staining.
- Red wine saturation covers an approximate 3 ft by 4 ft section of carpet adjacent to the king bed.
- The bathroom vanity mirror displays a 14-inch stress fracture across the lower left pane.

## Found Property
- Left-side nightstand drawer contained one pair of prescription eyeglasses and an Apple charging block.
- The guest safe was left in locked status; security bypassed the unit to verify contents.
- Items collected from nightstand drawer were cataloged into the lost and found log by Maria Okafor.

## Action Taken & Escalation
- Photographs taken of damaged carpet, bedside lamp, and vanity mirror at 11:00 AM.
- Room 418 placed out of order until carpet extraction and mirror replacement are completed.
- Maintenance notified to replace the mirror and repair wall backing in Room 318 by 2:00 PM.
- Front desk informed to place incident billing hold against guest Wendy Ellison.

errors.quote: The guest safe was left in locked status; security bypassed the unit to verify contents.
errors.explanation: When reporting a locked departure safe that was bypassed and inspected, the report must state whether any guest contents were found inside or confirm that the safe was empty.
errors.fix: The guest safe was left in locked status; security bypassed the unit to verify contents and confirmed it was empty.

errors.quote: Maintenance notified to replace the mirror and repair wall backing in Room 318 by 2:00 PM.
errors.explanation: The incident report is specifically for Room 418 as established throughout the document, but the work order incorrectly specifies Room 318.
errors.fix: Maintenance notified to replace the mirror and repair wall backing in Room 418 by 2:00 PM.
